data.name: Ivanshi
data.gender_notes: Ivanshi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ivanshi is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess of prosperity and abundance, Shri. It symbolizes wealth, happiness, and success in all aspects of life. This name was given to girls born under the belief that they would bring prosperity to their families. The name Ivanshi carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ivanshi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Blessing of Goddess Laxmi, symbolizing abundance and prosperity
data.etymology: Ivanshi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ivanshi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Ivanshi was an ancient Indian king and the founder of the Ikshvaku dynasty, which is believed to have ruled from approximately 1300 BCE to 500 BCE. He is also known by the epithet 'Sahasrarjuna', meaning 'Lord of a Thousand Heroes'.

historical_references.reference: Ivanshi is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. He is described as the ancestor of Rama, the hero of the Ramayana, and the progenitor of the Solar Dynasty.

Rooted in Hindu mythology, Ivanshi is believed to mean 'Goddess Lakshmi' or 'Goddess Saraswati', symbolizing wealth, knowledge, and prosperity. This name is commonly seen on various platforms where names and spirituality are popular topics. On Pinterest, boards dedicated to baby names and Hindu mythology frequently feature Ivanshi, with users adding images of the name written in various calligraphy styles or using the name in religious contexts. Instagram also has a large presence of the name, with many Indian and Hindu communities using the hashtag #Ivanshi to share posts related to the name, its meaning, or as a tribute to loved ones with the same name. Lastly, on BabyCenter, a popular pregnancy and parenting website, Ivanshi is a frequently searched and discussed name among expectant mothers, with many choosing the name for their newborn babies due to its meanings and association with Hindu goddesses.
